title: Doom the Dark Ages
description: This mod adds weapons from the doom the dark ages game
body:
![FIRST-PERSON VIEW](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a8e7494c6b61a79d0b7f6ddcb8270811317293f.png)
![3RD PERSON VIEW](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97f83c8e5445ffd40dc8d0207346e872e7c6065b.png)THIS MOD IS IN ALPHA, SO SOME ITEMS MIGHT NOT HAVE GOOD MODELS

This mod will add weapons from the Doom the Dark Ages game. 
There are 4 weapons:
The Shield Saw: you can throw it [left-click], block [right-click], and dash twards entities [left-click while holding rick-click]

Combat Shotgun: a shotgun based off of the Dark Ages counterpart

Flail, a melee weapon that deals more damage to mobs with armor

Super Shotgun: a shotgun based off of the Dark Ages counterpart

Creative ammo box: an item that when you have it in your inventory, you do not need to have ammo

Doom Slayer Armor: extremly powerful armor 12x more powerful than netherite. When you press C with the armor it will deal melee damage to mobs, that will give all of your weapons ammo
